name: AWS
requirements: EKS API access, CSI storage, ingress, ECR or another OCI registry; refresh short-lived registry credentials.

name: Azure
requirements: AKS API access, CSI storage, ingress, ACR or another OCI registry; validate Entra and image-pull identity.

name: Alibaba Cloud
requirements: ACK API access, CSI storage, ingress, Container Registry or another OCI registry; validate regional egress and RAM identities.

name: Google Cloud
requirements: Existing production runs on GKE. A fresh installation with the portable chart still needs acceptance testing.

name: Oracle Cloud
requirements: OKE API access, CSI storage, ingress and separately provisioned OCI registry credentials.

name: DigitalOcean
requirements: DOKS API access, storage, ingress and registry access.

name: On-premises
requirements: Operator-provided load balancer or gateway, storage, DNS, TLS, registry, PostgreSQL and cluster API access.

name: Other providers
requirements: Use the same portable installation contract; validate networking, storage, identity and registry behavior on the selected distribution.

name: Cloudflare DNS / CDN
requirements: Use alongside a Kubernetes target. Configure DNS, origin routing, trusted origin TLS and challenge handling independently; provider API automation is not implemented.

name: Cloudflare Workers / Containers
requirements: Requires a separate Workers/Wrangler deployment adapter. The Kubernetes Helm installer cannot deploy the AIO control plane to this target.
